name: starflask_generate_image
description: Create a Starflask text-to-image (or image-edit) generation job. Returns immediately with a job id ({"data":{"id":"<uuid>"}}) — the job runs asynchronously, so poll it with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.image_url (a downloadable presigned URL). Provide a `prompt`; optionally choose a `model_key` (default ideogram-v3 — great typography; others: gpt-image-2, gpt-image-2-hi, nano-banana, nano-banana-edit), an `aspect_ratio` (e.g. 16:9, 1:1, 9:16), an `image_style_key` (see starflask_list_styles), and `image_url` to edit an existing image (upload it first with starflask_upload_media and pass the returned url). Use starflask_list_models to discover model keys and their exact params.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate (or the edit instruction when image_url is set).

model_key.description: Optional image model key. Defaults to ideogram-v3. See starflask_list_models.

image_style_key.description: Optional style key from starflask_list_styles (e.g. "photorealistic", "cinematic"). Omit to use the default style.

image_url.description: Optional URL of an existing image to edit (from starflask_upload_media or a prior image job). Pair with an editing model like nano-banana-edit.
